subject: Expo badge capture: on-site local cache & CRM mapping plan
messages:

Subject: Badge scanner & data handling for Berlin trade show

Hi Vivek,

Quick intro — we're running the EU trade show in Berlin (20–22 Nov) and need a robust badge-capture plan for the main hall and 3 breakout zones (~30k attendees). A few non-negotiables from Legal/Privacy:

- Local device cache must be encrypted at rest with a 48-hour auto-delete after sync.
- Consent copy must be available in EN/DE/FR and displayed on Kiosk before capture.
- If offline, devices should export a signed CSV bundle (SHA256) on USB or encrypted transfer to the on-site laptop.

Logistics asks for Redwood:
1) Confirm supported scanner models / firmware (we plan to rent BadgeCo devices).
2) Provide the field-to-CRM mapping (HubSpot + Salesforce) and a fallback CSV schema.
3) Share a pre-event dry-run checklist and who will be on-call during deploy.

Attached: scanner_spec_v3.pdf, expo_site_map.png.

Can you propose a short test plan and confirm whether Redwood can do the encrypted local cache + 48h auto-purge? Budget for the devices is tight, so a simple CSV fallback is fine as long as it's automated.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Diaz
Event Operations Manager — ExpoOrg GmbH
Attachments: scanner_spec_v3.pdf (spec stub), expo_site_map.png (image stub)
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Sara Diaz <sara.diaz@expoorg.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Badge scanner & data handling for Berlin trade show

Sara — thanks for the clear brief. Short answers up front: yes, we can support an encrypted local cache with a 48-hour auto-purge, and we can produce both HubSpot and Salesforce mappings plus a signed CSV fallback.

Proposed next steps (high level):
- Ben will validate BadgeCo firmware compatibility (we need their 2.4+ builds for USB encryption APIs).
- Lauren will author three consent copy variants (EN/DE/FR) and route to your privacy team for sign-off.
- We'll deliver a field mapping document and a one-page dry-run checklist by EOD Friday (2026-10-15).

Operational notes:
- Local cache architecture: AES-256 at rest; device generates ephemeral key pair and we rotate keys on successful sync to our on-site aggregator. Auto-delete triggered on successful ingest confirmation from the aggregator (or after 48h).
- Fallback: signed CSV with header row, device id, capture_ts (ISO8601), badge_id, email, first_name, last_name, company, consent_flag, consent_lang, source_zone. We'll map those to CRM fields in the attached mapping doc.

Can you confirm BadgeCo will grant access to firmware SFTP for a pre-event test? Also confirm whether Cafe Hall requires DE-first copy (many attendees are DE-pref).

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head, Field Integrations — Redwood Inference

Hi all — following up with the CRM mapping and test checklist. Attaching crm_field_map_v1.csv (stub). Key mapping notes below — please review and flag mismatches.

Mapping summary (device -> CRM):
- badge_id -> salesforce:Contact.External_Id__c | hubspot:properties.external_id
- capture_ts -> salesforce:Activity__c.Capture_Time__c | hubspot:properties.capture_timestamp
- email -> salesforce:Contact.Email | hubspot:properties.email
- first_name / last_name -> standard name fields
- company -> salesforce:Account.Name (lookup) / hubspot:company
- consent_flag -> salesforce:Contact.Consent_to_Marketing__c (Y/N) | hubspot:properties.consent_opt_in
- consent_lang -> salesforce:Contact.Consent_Language__c | hubspot:properties.consent_language
- source_zone -> salesforce:Lead.Source_Zone__c | hubspot:properties.exhibit_zone

Consent handling: store raw consent_text in a attachments bucket (immutable) and keep consent_flag + consent_lang on the contact record. For EU attendees, retention policy: CRM copy retained per contract, but local device cache purged after 48h.

Pre-event dry-run checklist (short):
1) Firmware smoke test (BadgeCo 2.4+): handshake + encrypted local store created
2) Sync test: device -> aggregator -> staging CRM (SF sandbox + HS dev)
3) CSV fallback generation + SHA256 signature verification on ingest
4) Consent language toggles and kiosk flow verification (EN/DE/FR)
5) Post-sync auto-purge validation and key rotation test

On-call plan: Ben (field ops) primary; Vivek secondary; Lauren for consent questions. Ben cell: +1 650 555 0123.

Attachments: crm_field_map_v1.csv (mapping stub)

—Ben
